name: flexpart-gpu scientific thresholds
scope: Applies to evaluation reports with schema 1.0.0. Thresholds are versioned separately from evaluation code and must never be loosened to make a candidate pass.

status_classes.INTEGRITY_ERROR: Technical failure: missing artifacts, unpinned oracle, grid/window mismatch, negative or non-finite fields, or hash mismatch. No scientific statement is made.
status_classes.DIAGNOSTIC: Metrics were computed but no parity verdict is given (for example ETEX mini with demonstrated input differences, single-seed stochastic runs, or normalized shape-only comparisons).
status_classes.PASS: All evaluated scientific criteria for the case scope hold.
status_classes.FAIL: At least one evaluated scientific criterion is violated.

criteria.rationale: Candidate mass budget (remaining plus deposited plus decayed versus released mass) must close to single-precision summation order. Mirrors the Rust mass-conservation tests (relative tolerance 2e-6 plus absolute floor) and matches fixtures/corpus/thresholds.json mass_conservation_rel (1e-5); the slightly wider 1e-5 covers JSON f32 round-trips. A normalized concentration field comparison never satisfies this criterion. Skipped for deposition/decay cases whose removed-mass reservoirs are not recorded.
Concentration and mass fields must be finite and non-negative. Any violation is an integrity error, not a scientific result.
Time windows, averaging, sampling, grid cells and layer heights must match verifiably before any model comparison. Mismatched inputs fail instead of being silently interpolated.

diagnostic_only.rationale: Single-seed gridded shape diagnostics. Not a parity verdict: stochastic spread needs at least 10 independent seeds with a controllable oracle seed, which the current runners do not expose.

The ETEX mini run remains a pipeline and observation-pairing regression. Its input audit reports INPUT_EQUIVALENCE_NOT_DEMONSTRATED (137 native hybrid levels with eta velocity versus 16 fixed AGL levels with omega-derived velocity, plus differing timesteps and PBL diagnostics). No concentration parity is claimed.

multiseed_policy.rationale: Issue #6 requires at least 10 independent seeds for stochastic comparisons. Runs without a controllable oracle seed are labeled NOT_SUITABLE_FOR_MULTISEED_PARITY and stay diagnostic.

change_policy: Threshold changes require a new versioned file with date and scientific justification. Loosening a threshold because a candidate fails is prohibited.
